import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas, handle text numbers)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (it's currently text due to negative value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix sex labels (standardize case)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Filter out invalid body_mass_g values (out of range: 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Filter out invalid flipper_length_mm values (out of range: 170-235)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and sum body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
